title: Label V2 & Event-Based Target Engineering — Integrity Report

evidence_status.reason: No production dataset available in the test environment. All statistics below are derived from deterministic synthetic price paths used in unit tests, not from real Indian equity/F&O market data.
evidence_status.synthetic_note: Synthetic OHLCV paths were constructed with known mathematical outcomes so that correctness of label logic can be verified, not to produce statistically meaningful label distributions.

bugs_fixed.description: Early return for single-bar window returned `float(c.iloc[-1]) * 0.01` which equals `close * 0.01` (e.g. 1.0 for a ₹100 stock) instead of the intended fractional ATR of 0.01 (1%). This made barriers 100× too wide on the first bar, causing all golden-path golden tests to fail with TIME_LIMIT instead of TP/SL.
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed return to `0.01` (a 1% ATR fraction), independent of close price.

bugs_fixed.description: Contract expiry was checked inside the forward scan loop but the is_incomplete early-exit path (triggered when i+horizon >= n) bypassed the expiry cap entirely. Events starting at or after contract_expiry were also generated instead of being skipped.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added expiry cap to the is_incomplete path; added guard at loop entry to skip bars at or after contract_expiry.

bugs_fixed.description: All `pd.Timestamp(tz_aware_datetime, tz='UTC')` calls raise ValueError in pandas ≥ 2.x (Python 3.14 environment). The tz= parameter is invalid when the datetime already carries tzinfo.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added `_to_ts()` helper in both files that calls `pd.Timestamp(dt)` then `.tz_convert('UTC')` when tzinfo is already set, or `.tz_localize('UTC')` when naive.

Inside _compute_risk_adjusted_return(). Computes the volatility-adjusted forward return which becomes the ranking label target. The result is returned as a label Series, never merged into the feature matrix.

known_limitations: No real Indian equity/F&O OHLCV data available in test environment — label distribution statistics are INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
sklearn (PurgedKFold integration test) not installed — 1 purging contract test skipped.
talib (ATR computation in features/technical.py) not installed — pipeline ATR integration test skipped.
Cost model is DATA_UNAVAILABLE by default — net returns not computed until broker API costs are populated.
Intraday tick data not available — intrabar ambiguity cannot be resolved below daily OHLCV granularity.
Sector peer universe for sector-relative labels requires a live data feed — returns DATA_UNAVAILABLE in offline tests.
Label distribution (TP%/SL%/TIME%) on real Indian market data is not yet characterised — expected class imbalance ~30/20/50 is an estimate only.
